SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(oi.product_price) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_type = 'beverage' THEN oi.product_price ELSE 0 END) AS beverage_revenue
FROM jaffle_shop.dev.order_items oi
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, LOWER(MAX(product_type)) AS product_type FROM jaffle_shop.dev.products GROUP BY product_id) p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE LOWER(c.customer_name) = 'ryan byrd'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
